local llm mac mini.title: Local LLM benchmarks on 16GB Mac mini
local llm mac mini.content: On a 16GB Apple Silicon Mac mini the Llama 3.1 8B Q4 model runs at roughly 18 tokens per second using llama.cpp with Metal acceleration. Mistral 7B Q4 reaches about 22 tokens per second but uses more context memory.

local llm mac mini.title: Ollama on Apple Silicon
local llm mac mini.content: Ollama wraps llama.cpp and supports Metal. On 16GB systems Phi-3 mini and Llama 3.1 8B fit comfortably while leaving headroom for the operating system.

local llm mac mini.title: Updated 2026 ranking of local models
local llm mac mini.content: Newer Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct quantized to Q4_K_M outperforms Llama 3.1 8B on instruction following while running at similar speed on a 16GB Mac mini. This supersedes the 2025 ranking.

agentic memory.title: MemGPT overview
agentic memory.content: MemGPT introduces hierarchical memory for LLM agents with a working set and an archival store managed by tool calls.

agentic memory.title: Letta agentic memory
agentic memory.content: Letta is the productized successor to MemGPT and exposes a REST API plus persistent agent state across sessions.
